limits: Synthetic operational hypotheses, no new human/expert moral validation.
Reserve only4families; no best-layer selection. Original cleaned reference test previously examined.
Oracle cards contain authored relevant source spans; upper bound, not autonomous evidence selection.
MET-D released weights used with forced grounds; no selector or new self-distillation; short generated views may truncate.
Harm→repair is typed and contextual, not assumed reflection or moral cancellation.

runtime_replay_diagnostic.interpretation: Exact saved weights and original32-pair/64-text batch layout do not numerically reproduce historical predictions under the new pinned runtime. Layout alone does not explain drift. No fitting, threshold selection, dependency changes, new resources or main inference rerun.

restorative_transfer_diagnostic.rationale: High repair-versus-sanction alignment might be generic positive valence. Check whether translation adds anything beyond raw topic similarity among equally positive candidate repairs.
restorative_transfer_diagnostic.limits: Same six previously inspected authored families; no valence-matched non-reparative benefit control; no expert sufficiency judgments.
